description:
## Problem
The pipeline ranks every run as its own row; the meta-leaderboard keeps the best rank per variant with no version (R). Methodology answer 3 requires the median across runs with every run published.

## Change (_project/scripts/explorer_pipeline/)
- Emit, per result: class, lane, labels, score and score source from the rule; identity and comparison version; observed engine; "row counts not checked" and "single iteration" labels.
- Per identity and cohort: one median row. As methodology answer 3 says, take the median of each query's time across the runs, then compute the lane's score from those medians; show the run count and the spread of the run-level scores. Every run stays reachable. Ranking uses median rows.
- A partial result (power and throughput, no refresh) enters both the power-only and the throughput cohort.
- The meta-leaderboard combines ranks of the leaderboard version only, never ranks from different versions under one label.
- Leaderboards: per platform and variant, the newest released version that has a ranked result (owner decision 4). A version view lists all.
- Bump the read-model version. Update browser-duckdb-schema.sql, visible_metrics.yaml and check_explorer_compat.py.

## Decision gates
- Merge only after crr-b2 is deployed. Rankings for stored results change on the public site at this step; the labels are already rendered by crr-b2. Confirm on the deployed site that a power-only TPC result shows its labels before closing; if not, revert this merge and report.
- If a platform's rank changes by more than three places in any cohort because of the median rule, list it in the pull request body. No stop.

## Guardrails (apply to every item of this plan)
- Fix the root cause for every platform and benchmark. No rule, exception, label or test may name a platform or a version matrix. Only the pvm-p* items may name Polars, and only to run and stage that run's files.
- Never edit a stored result file to make it pass. Outcomes change only through the rule.
- Any change to the outcome of a stored result must show in the committed outcome snapshot diff in the same pull request and be explained in its body.
- No new stored class value. No reader may decide anything from benchmark.compliance_class, conformance_class or summary.tpc_metrics.suppressed.
- Paths, line numbers and counts in this plan were read on 2026-11-22 at develop 93f3360. Re-read before editing; report drift, do not guess.
- AGENTS.md applies: linked worktree, one pull request per item, close at the merged pull request, heavy work only through make heavy-run, no live cloud run without owner approval in that task.
- At a decision gate, follow the recorded default. If its stop condition is met, stop and report to the owner. Never substitute a different owner decision.
- Read crr-00-corpus-rule-remediation-plan first: it holds the owner decisions, the rule table and the fault types (T1 to T5).
